_source: Git-tracked fallback for curia-research-daily and curia-suggestion-review's daily briefing (see docs/data/pending-review-queue.json's own note for the full diagnosis — the Artifact tool's write_db is unreachable from this job's headless execution environment, read_db is fine). Each run appends one entry here instead of writing directly to Curia Command's `briefings` collection; synced in from a human or an interactive session during a normal check-in. `synced` flips to true once it's landed in the portal.

entries.title: 8 venues + Chester (new Cheshire district) promoted; 1 rejected as a real chain, 1 naming mix-up sent for review
entries.summary: Independently re-verified all 10 pending candidates in venue-suggestions.json with a 2026-09-16 suggestedDate and the sole pending district candidate (Chester), promoting 8 venues (Pottery Corner, Chorlton; The Damson Tree Cafe, Cheadle Hulme; Ebenezer's Craft Beer Emporium, Nantwich; St Peter's Church & Norman Chapel, Prestbury; BeefnBerry Bistro, Macclesfield; The Blarney Barrel, Bramhall; The Old Bakery Didsbury; Runway Pilates, Alderley Edge) and Chester itself. Mouro Coffee Bar (Heaton Moor) was rejected, reversing the original researcher's own finding — fresh search found it's actually a real, actively expanding four-site coffee brand (Heaton Moor plus two Altrincham sites plus a fourth opened May 2026 in the Northern Quarter), past this file's small-sibling-group allowance. Underbank (Stockport (Underbanks)) needed a genuine human call rather than a promote/reject guess: it appears to describe the same real venue as this file's own already-promoted 'The Underbank' entry, while a separate, different venue with a near-identical name (Benji Taylor's live-music venue) seems to be the one that name actually belongs to — a naming mix-up, sent to pending-review-queue.json. Curia Command's pending_review collection (checked via read_db) had zero decided items to apply this run. Prana, Buon Cibo and Rustik remain unchanged in pending-review-queue.json, still awaiting a human decision. The closure-audit rotating slice (Manchester Craft and Design Centre, The Horsfall, Bar Etna, Knutcraft at the Ruskin Rooms, Mobberley Ice Cream Coffee House) found no closures — all five re-confirmed still trading.

entries.title: Research-tool outage limited today's pass to 3 promotions; 11 items left pending, untouched
entries.summary: A genuine research-tool outage hit for most of this run — WebSearch mostly returned 'unavailable' errors or surfaced only Wikipedia-indexed content, and WebFetch was blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED) for essentially every other domain tried (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Instagram, Facebook, Tripadvisor, Companies House, CAMRA/whatpub, even plain Wikipedia). Only 3 of the 10 new pending candidates (all in the Chester district) had enough Wikipedia coverage to be genuinely independently re-verified and were promoted: Storyhouse, Chester Cathedral, Grosvenor Museum. The other 7 new candidates (6 in Chester plus Eden in Heaton Moor), all 4 long-stuck pending-review-queue items (Prana, Buon Cibo, Rustik, the Underbank naming mix-up), and today's closure-audit slice could not be honestly verified one way or the other, so nothing was promoted, rejected, or newly queued for any of them — they remain exactly as they were, pending a re-run once tooling recovers. Curia Command's pending_review collection was checked via read_db (unaffected by the outage) and had zero decided items to apply.

entries.summary: First run in about four weeks (last briefing: 2026-09-17) — a real backlog had built up. Independently re-verified all 159 pending venue candidates and all 7 pending district candidates with fresh research: 121 venues + 6 districts (Lymm, Ramsbottom, Monton, Frodsham, Sale, Marple) promoted; 9 venues + 1 district (Rusholme/Curry Mile — real but doesn't clear the 'curated high-end districts only' bar) rejected, each with a specific reason (closures, renamed venues, fabricated-looking entries, a duplicate); 29 venues sent to pending-review-queue.json for a human call (thin or conflicting sourcing after a real fresh search, not a coin-flip). Two real closures (Blossom Street Social, Nam — both Ancoats) turned up incidentally while verifying unrelated new candidates at the same addresses; both queued for human removal rather than auto-removed. The routine closure-audit slice (5 Riyadh/Diriyah venues) found no closures. Curia Command's pending_review collection had nothing decided since the last run. Pushed to a review branch and opened a PR rather than straight to master, since this environment's own permission policy requires it — see the PR for the full file diff.
